name: Handle
summary: An Atmosphere handle, always with an @, isolated so it reads correctly inside Arabic text, and breaking after its dots when long.

when: Wherever a handle appears in running text.

props.name: handle
props.description: The handle, with or without its @.

states.name: Long
states.description: Breaks after its dots, then anywhere, never overflowing.

guidelines: Always show a handle with its @ in running text.

terms.meaning: An Atmosphere account's username, such as @sam.bsky.social.

dosAndDonts.dont: Cut it short with an ellipsis.

evidence.point: Handles are isolated with <bdi> so their dots and @ don't reorder inside right-to-left text (#6).
